jezero.label: Regional climate context (orbital, gridded)
jezero.quantity: Column dust optical depth, 9.3 um absorption, normalised to 610 Pa
jezero.credit: Montabone et al. (2015, Icarus 251; 2020, JGR Planets) - LMD Mars dust climatology v2, CC BY-SA 3.0. Gridded (observation-only) maps.
jezero.time_resolution: one map per sol (time steps as stored in the file)
jezero.caveat: Describes the whole atmospheric column over a cell hundreds of km across. It is not astronaut visibility, a landing limit or a forecast. Converting it to either would need separate, validated modelling.
